name: Fair Lady
steps: Swipe left to open the bathroom door.
Drag the shower head to the girl.
Use the mop to clean the bathroom floor.
Put the high heels on the girl.
Use the perfume on the girl.
Take the hat from the poster and put it on the girl.
Use the paint to cover the stain on her skirt.
Apply the makeup to the girl.
Use the comb on the girl’s hair.
Swipe up on the girl to fix her posture.
Give the pronunciation book to the girl.
Open the window, then use the watering can on the flower basket.
